title: Zero Dollars: 10 Things Locals Do for Free
description: Ten Pune pauses that require no ticket or purchase: gardens for everyday walks, active places of worship, a rock-cut sanctuary, and an audiovisual museum.

cards.title: Watch the free audiovisual show at Darshan Museum
cards.subtitle: Follow Sadhu Vaswani’s life through staged sets, projections, holography, and an hour-long or 90-minute show.
cards.notes: Admission is free for visitors aged three and above. Groups should call ahead; the museum closes on Thursdays and specified public holidays.
cards.short_summary: A ticketless, technology-led museum experience near Pune railway station.

cards.title: Enter the BAPS mandir for free
cards.subtitle: Walk through a contemporary stone temple whose carvings reference deities and Maharashtra’s architectural heritage.
cards.notes: The mandir’s official visitor information explicitly states that entry is free. Respect the published dress, photography, and conduct rules.
cards.short_summary: Free public entry to a richly carved Hindu temple complex.
cards.source_title: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Pune — Visitor Information

cards.title: Step into Pataleshwar Cave Temple for free
cards.subtitle: Leave Jangali Maharaj Road for an unfinished rock-cut Shiva sanctuary with heavy basalt pillars and a courtyard Nandi pavilion.
cards.notes: The cited visitor page lists no entry fee. This remains an active religious site as well as an ASI-protected monument, so move quietly around worshippers.
cards.short_summary: An admission-free rock-cut temple embedded in central Pune.
cards.source_title: Pataleshwar Caves / Temple, Pune — Entry Fee and Visitor Information | Pune Tourism

cards.title: Walk the riverside paths at Bund Garden for free
cards.subtitle: Use the garden as Pune’s morning crowd does: for an unhurried loop beside the Mula-Mutha and the bund that gave the park its name.
cards.notes: The cited visitor page says entry is free for all. Stay within maintained public areas and check local conditions during heavy monsoon weather.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee riverside circuit used by everyday walkers and joggers.
cards.source_title: Bund Garden Pune — Timings and Entry Fee | Pune Tourism

cards.title: Take a free neighborhood walk through Kamala Nehru Park
cards.subtitle: Circle the paths beneath mature trees, pause on the lawns, or bring children to the play equipment during the park’s split daily sessions.
cards.notes: The cited park page explicitly states that there is no entry fee.
cards.short_summary: Ten acres of ticketless green space in Deccan Gymkhana.
cards.source_title: Kamala Nehru Park Pune — Timings and Entry Fee | Pune Tourism

cards.title: Visit Sarasbaug Ganpati Temple for free
cards.subtitle: Cross the garden to the island-like shrine known as Talyatla Ganapati and sit in on the rhythm of daily puja and aarti.
cards.notes: Temple entry is free, but the museum in the premises carries a separate nominal fee; skip it to keep this stop at zero rupees.
cards.short_summary: Free entry to the historic Ganapati shrine at the center of Saras Baug.
cards.source_title: Sarasbaug Ganpati Temple Pune — Entry Fee and Timings | Pune Tourism

cards.title: Enter Omkareshwar Temple for free
cards.subtitle: Look closely at the domes, carved stonework, and courtyard of this Peshwa-era Shiva temple beside the Mutha.
cards.notes: The cited visitor page explicitly lists entry as free. The temple closes between its morning and evening sessions.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket look at Peshwa-period temple architecture in Shaniwar Peth.
cards.source_title: Shree Omkareshwar Temple Pune — Timings and Entry Fee | Pune Tourism

cards.title: See Ohel David Synagogue without an entry fee
cards.subtitle: Visit the red-brick Camp landmark, also called Lal Deval, whose tall clock tower rises above Ambedkar Road.
cards.notes: The cited visitor page lists no entry fee. Because this is an active place of worship, contact the synagogue before visiting and carry identification in case current security procedures require it.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to Pune’s prominent nineteenth-century synagogue.
cards.source_title: Ohel David Jewish Synagogue, Pune — Timings and Entry Fee | Pune Tourism

cards.title: Pray and share maha prasadam for free at Balaji Mandir
cards.subtitle: Join the daily worship cycle at the Tirumala-inspired Venkateswara temple south of Pune; the visitor information also documents a free meal.
cards.notes: No fee is required to enter and pray, and maha prasadam is described as free. Offerings and other purchases remain optional.
cards.short_summary: Free temple entry, with complimentary maha prasadam available during a visit.
cards.source_title: Balaji Mandir Pune — Timings, Entry Fee and Maha Prasadam | Pune Tourism

cards.title: Walk through Narayani Dham for free
cards.subtitle: Enter the Katraj temple complex to observe its shrines and the cadence of worship without buying a ticket.
cards.notes: The cited visitor page explicitly states that Narayani Dham has no entry fee. Donations and devotional purchases are optional.
cards.short_summary: A spacious Katraj temple complex with admission-free public access.
cards.source_title: Narayani Dham Pune — Timings and Entry Fee | Pune Tourism
